scope: Released television only through S3E10; no novel spoilers
method: Opened public episode recaps, creator/cast interviews and official release information; this is not a claim of having watched every episode directly.

chapter_claim_map.title: The cleaning
chapter_claim_map.evidence_boundary: Display deception is answered; a cleaner's individual motivation is not.
chapter_claim_map.original_analysis: A controlled ritual removes the returning witness.

chapter_claim_map.title: The suit
chapter_claim_map.evidence_boundary: Better sealing matters; the compound's precise composition and global conditions are unknown.
chapter_claim_map.original_analysis: Preparation compromises the independence of the supposed outside test.

chapter_claim_map.title: The screens
chapter_claim_map.evidence_boundary: The green flash occurs; it does not independently prove the current surface safe.
chapter_claim_map.original_analysis: Displayed evidence requires place, time and provenance.

chapter_claim_map.title: The stairs
chapter_claim_map.evidence_boundary: Transport and magnification restrictions exist; their exact original purpose is open.
chapter_claim_map.original_analysis: Costs of movement and inspection hinder coordination.

chapter_claim_map.title: The mirrors
chapter_claim_map.evidence_boundary: Hidden cameras are revealed; total surveillance is not established.
chapter_claim_map.original_analysis: Blind spots, interpretation and informants limit observation.

chapter_claim_map.title: The families
chapter_claim_map.evidence_boundary: Reproductive deception is shown and testified to; genetic causation is not established.
chapter_claim_map.original_analysis: Family stories offer a route for forbidden knowledge.

chapter_claim_map.title: The erased history
chapter_claim_map.evidence_boundary: Bernard describes a reset; the coded letter survives.
chapter_claim_map.original_analysis: Quinn may preserve a route to checking evidence rather than a complete explanation.

chapter_claim_map.title: The Legacy
chapter_claim_map.evidence_boundary: Restricted archives exist; complete origin knowledge is not assured.
chapter_claim_map.original_analysis: Access can recruit a successor while leaving them dependent.

chapter_claim_map.title: The door
chapter_claim_map.evidence_boundary: Remote Safeguard and no-contact rule established.
chapter_claim_map.original_analysis: Isolation prevents communities comparing accounts; original justification remains open.

chapter_claim_map.title: The lost memories
chapter_claim_map.evidence_boundary: Camille exploits and maintains memory loss; exact biology is fictional.
chapter_claim_map.original_analysis: Relationships can contradict the approved account of a person's life.

chapter_claim_map.title: Silo seventeen
chapter_claim_map.evidence_boundary: Survivors and deliberate attack revealed.
chapter_claim_map.original_analysis: Local evidence must replace the obsolete universal-poison explanation.

chapter_claim_map.title: The Algorithm
chapter_claim_map.evidence_boundary: Human voice, imposed identities and recurring memory established.
chapter_claim_map.original_analysis: An internal ally is plausible, with limits; memory is no guaranteed moral reversal.

chapter_claim_map.title: The Before Times
chapter_claim_map.evidence_boundary: Stated survival purpose and visible explosion established.
chapter_claim_map.original_analysis: Manufactured catastrophe is a strong but incomplete culpability theory.

chapter_claim_map.title: Helen and the relic
chapter_claim_map.evidence_boundary: Gift, pregnancy and placement established; genealogy unresolved.
chapter_claim_map.original_analysis: Recoverable influence need not require a blood relationship.

chapter_claim_map.title: The other silos
chapter_claim_map.evidence_boundary: Fifty versus fifty-one remains an account discrepancy.
chapter_claim_map.original_analysis: Map lights and a missing number do not identify a facility or census.

chapter_claim_map.title: The spare parts
chapter_claim_map.evidence_boundary: Critical Supply and the theft investigation are television premises; remaining stock and any central delivery route are unconfirmed.
chapter_claim_map.original_analysis: Stored inventory, renewable manufacturing and transferred repair skills imply different futures.

chapter_claim_map.title: The mayor's chair
chapter_claim_map.evidence_boundary: Juliette is a public leader whose account is managed; proposed reforms and council practices are hypothetical.
chapter_claim_map.original_analysis: Changes in officeholders can leave the routes for decisions unchanged.

chapter_claim_map.title: The first agreement
chapter_claim_map.evidence_boundary: The project is presented to early participants; no complete original contract or exit condition is established.
chapter_claim_map.original_analysis: Voluntary entry and the inherited restrictions of later generations require separate judgments.

chapter_claim_map.title: The message between neighbors
chapter_claim_map.evidence_boundary: A repaired radio permits contact; a durable public communications network has not been established.
chapter_claim_map.original_analysis: Modest practical exchanges could build cooperation while retaining checks on incoming accounts.

chapter_claim_map.title: The next person in the room
chapter_claim_map.evidence_boundary: Bernard appoints Lukas as shadow and grants access; a universal deliberate recruitment sequence is unconfirmed.
chapter_claim_map.original_analysis: Training requires sharing abilities that an apprentice may use to challenge the institution.

chapter_claim_map.title: The decision before morning
chapter_claim_map.evidence_boundary: The residents face incomplete knowledge; imagined councils and future ultimatums are explicitly hypothetical.
chapter_claim_map.original_analysis: Limited goals, reversible options and visible corrections could permit decisions without complete certainty.

chapter_claim_map.title: A way forward
chapter_claim_map.evidence_boundary: S18 survives one mechanism; its final liberation is not shown.
chapter_claim_map.original_analysis: Durable freedom requires verifiable communication, resources and shared access.
